title: nan
authors: Liu J.; Liang Y.; Xu D.; Gong X.; Hyyppä J.
key_contribution: Presents a ubiquitous positioning solution integrating GNSS with LiDAR odometry and 3D map for autonomous driving in urban environments during GNSS blockages.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
